review: Fresh independent local uncommitted v2 reliability acceptance
verdict: PASS for reviewed Linux-executable controller, persistence and publication boundaries; native and physical acceptance pending

sourceBoundary.workingTree: Current local uncommitted files; no remote checkout used

probes.name: Median boundary, choose once, cached full output reused by Save
probes.evidence: Fresh portrait median and exactly 0.95 square cases survive grid/order/crop changes without reinspection. Full inspection coalesces; Save performs no extra full render, copies the inspected URI, retains v2 aspect, and releases cache without releasing source files.

probes.name: Close and reopen during source inspection
probes.evidence: Late old square receipt cannot select aspect or launch previews for the reopened editor; current portrait receipt succeeds.

probes.name: Source URI changes while full inspection is pending
probes.evidence: Receipt is not cached, phase becomes error, Save returns false, no durable copy occurs, and output cache is released.

probes.name: Current versus old Image failure
probes.evidence: Current full inspection image failure invalidates Save. After explicit retry, an error for the old released full URI leaves the new ready state intact.

probes.name: Composite rename fault and relaunch recovery
probes.evidence: A v2 portrait grid with a retake and a filtered selection fails rename into staged state, never queues before confirmation, preserves all six source JPEG arrays byte-for-byte, then recovers on a fresh repository. Queue contains current selected/raw/composite assets and excludes the discarded old take.

probes.name: Foreign raw source rejection
probes.evidence: Attempting to create a look from another session raw file rejects render-source, retains current selection, and creates no upload jobs.

probes.name: Nine adversarial server ACK forms
probes.evidence: Reordered selection, reordered raw lineage, foreign raw ID, missing aspect, wrong aspect, wrong version, wrong composite ID, wrong layout, and an extra composite key all reject.

probes.name: Exact server ACK required before guest QR
probes.evidence: Wrong-aspect ACK leaves every queue row without guest capability and hides QR. Exact durable ACK on retry makes the selected/raw/composite rows ready while an unselected retake row remains unacknowledged.

probes.name: Native source inventory only
probes.evidence: Current source contract enumerates five Swift inputs, six JPEG resources and twenty expected methods; no Apple compilation or execution is implied.

staticReview.files: Current template editor/studio/native bridge, local persistence/types, publication/sharing/finalization, App lifecycle, native engine/module and native source preparation contract
staticReview.geometry: Source routes v1 grid to 2400x2100, all strips to 1200x3600, v2 portrait grid to 2400x3000 and v2 square grid to 2400x2400. Legacy window/palette/footer function bodies compare byte-identical with local HEAD.
staticReview.inspection: Native metadata inspection uses JPEG/type/count/resource bounds, upright EXIF dimensions (5 through 8 swap axes), streamed source SHA256, and average of middle ratios with strict less-than-0.95 portrait threshold. Rendering applies EXIF orientation once and preserves the persisted aspect.
staticReview.ownership: Native module requires four unique IDs and canonical ID.jpg files directly in Documents/photobooth after symlink resolution; release authorizes only its UUID JPEG cache. Durable repository checks selected and original ownership, slot lineage and verified files before composite save, confirmation and publication.
staticReview.lifecycle: App background handler closes the editor. Controller generation checks reject late preview/inspection/full results; output copying is protected from close-time release and disposed after copy finishes. On-screen Image load establishes Save presentation gating in App/Studio. Controller receipt errors before Save invalidate ready state.
staticReview.documentation: The new v2 README section accurately describes implemented inspection, strict aspect schema, geometry and current expected inventory. Historical v1 counts and old v1 evidence are retained as prior scope; no native pass is inferred from them.

runBoundaries.nativeAppleExecution: NOT RUN: CoreImage, ImageIO, CoreText, Expo bridge integration, Apple compiler typechecking, XCTest assertions and JPEG attachments require the supported Apple environment.
runBoundaries.remoteCI: Not queried or rerun by this independent review. Per task boundary, existing remote run concerns old 15-test source plus boot repair and cannot establish this uncommitted v2 source.
runBoundaries.physicalIPad: NOT RUN: camera capture, EXIF on actual capture, UIKit image decoding, offline power-loss durability, OS Photos, memory/performance, full-size visual review and device lifecycle need device acceptance.
runBoundaries.syntheticPersistence: Bounded LocalRepository probes use in-memory byte arrays and injected failures; they execute production repository logic but do not establish filesystem power-loss or SQLite behavior.
runBoundaries.syntheticRendering: Controller probes inject native-shaped metadata/receipts; they do not decode or render native images.
runBoundaries.network: No real API, publication, downloads, SMS or credentials used.
runBoundaries.mutations: Only ignored .cache test/report helper files and this requested report were written. Product sources, original photos/data, v1 reports and git history were not changed.

harnessNotes: An initial independent fixture used Array.map(structuredClone), which passed the numeric index as clone options. The fixture was corrected to an explicit value callback; no product fault was involved. The final hash-bounded nine-probe run passes.
